summary: Adds standalone local parametric CAD with exact modelling, geometry exchange and shared human/agent workflows connected to CAM.
warning: Installed post packages, saved CAM revisions, post execution events and controller output contracts are unchanged. CAD handoff creates a new detached CAM project; review its contours, threading and machining setup before generating output. A numerical roundoff correction can classify freshly calculated nearly tangent intersections differently; existing saved geometry and output are not rewritten. Exact section transfer refuses unsupported or ambiguous curves instead of approximating them.

checklist.schema: App version advances once to 0.0.697. New CAD document and save-envelope schemas start independently at version 1. Curve extends this unreleased CAD feature union; earlier CAD preview builds cannot read documents containing Curve features. Existing CAD documents remain readable without rewriting their geometry. UPID, post, package, engine API and existing workbench schemas are unchanged. CAD saves live in the additive cad/documents namespace.
checklist.events: Post execution-event contracts, compilation, audit and invocation are unchanged. CAD uses its own immutable versioned draft and bounded history. Handoff validates analytic millimetre geometry through the ordinary portable-UPID import operation.
checklist.capabilities: Installed post capability claims are unchanged. Desktop CAD adds automatic sketch regions, directly drawn line/three-point-arc paths, independent open reference curves with exact measurements and DXF exchange, editable analytic imported paths, STEP and closed STL import, selective fillets/chamfers, planar-face inward shells, exact topology inspection, Boolean operations, linear/circular solid patterns, ordered smooth/ruled lofts and parametric history. Versioned WebMCP tools reuse the same import, edit, build, selection, save and handoff checks. Compact feature registration retains complete per-kind discovery and strict execution validation. Curve references have no material or CAM roles and do not load the solid engine on their own.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Existing controller formatting, feed policy and exact-post output remain authoritative. CAD JSON preserves editable history; STEP exports exact BRep, STL exports a mesh, and sketch DXF preserves analytic curves. Failed solid features block solid export. Sketch and solid-section handoffs create separate CAM projects without overwriting prior revisions.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No migration or installed-package rewrite. CAD storage covers browser cache and folder adapters with exact hash conflicts, journal recovery and write-boundary guards. Full workbench backup includes CAD files; cleanup retains the entire CAD namespace. CAD save and CAM creation are separate commits. The lazy OpenCascade worker is distributed with pinned corresponding sources and rebuild instructions.
checklist.verification: Independent numerical, kernel, storage, UI and agent-boundary review. Latest complete Vitest run: 268 files / 2,774 tests pass. Subsequent CAD coverage: 57 files / 665 tests; a topology stress test timed out during simultaneous browser load and passed all 14 suite cases on isolated retry. All 23 production CAD/kernel workflows pass, including independent Curve construction, exact DXF round-trip, no solid-engine load for references, far-origin graphics, failed-module draft recovery, lofts, patterns, exchange, save/reload, section handoff and real graphics recovery. Production TypeScript/build, documentation/schema parity, pinned source distributions and release gate pass. Latest full production Chromium baseline: 105 tests pass with one existing externally seeded-workbench case skipped. Generated post contract parity, UPID conformance, all three unchanged Robofil 2.6.0 fixtures and complete machine-package validation passed at the first checkpoint. Native Codex WebMCP verifies exact Curve measurement, draft provenance, PNG capture and saving. See the CAD checkpoint review for detailed evidence and measured performance. No physical controller verification is claimed.

testedPosts.scope: Unchanged post passes all three conformance fixtures and complete machine-package validation. CAD does not bypass the existing saved-revision, active-setup or audited output requirements. No physical controller verification is claimed.

publicNotes.summary: Design parametric parts and send exact contours into the machining workbench.
changes: Design in CAD opens a desktop workspace with one compact document header, adjustable feature and properties panels, sketch canvas, solid viewport and history timeline.

Create dimension-driven sketches, connected lines and three-point arcs with automatic material nesting, and exact solids with pads, revolves, ordered smooth/ruled lofts, Booleans, selected-edge fillets/chamfers, inward shells, transforms, mirrors and linear/circular patterns. Reuse named parameters in dimension expressions.
Send a sketch or previewed final-solid section directly into a new CAM project with analytic lines and circular arcs.

Save editable CAD documents locally; import and export CAD JSON, STEP, STL and sketch DXF. Edit imported line and arc dimensions while preserving source originals. Capture the visible sketch or solid as PNG.

Agents can discover schemas, construct and measure exact line/arc profiles, import geometry, edit the same draft, inspect exact faces and edges, control the viewport, save and hand off designs through version-checked WebMCP tools.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed posts, saved CAM revisions and controller output contracts are unchanged. CAD transfers create detached CAM projects. Fresh near-tangent intersection calculations include a numerical roundoff correction; saved files are not rewritten.
publicNotes.action: Choose Design in CAD, create or import a part, then use File > Send to CAM for a sketch or File > Section for CAM for the finished solid. Review the resulting machining plan before output.
